'''Caira''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who worked with [[Melvirre]]. An expert on ancient [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] folklore and culture, Caira enthusiastically pointed out [[Kucha-sculpt|''kucha''-sculpts]] that decorated the walls of [[Terman Station]]. Caira believed that if they were genuine, they would be worth a fortune.<ref name="SSR" />
